name: Unsettling Presence
description:
While wearing a Mesmer's mask, when you target a creature with a Mesmer ability, you gain +1d on skill checks for that ability for each Condition the creature has checked. If an ability targets multiple creatures, use the creature with the fewest Conditions checked to determine this bonus.

If any of the creatures have ever seen your unmasked face, you gain no bonus.

Describe your unsettling presence.
